pages.title: Life Star
pages.text: §c§lAcquisition: §r Place a Golden Apple in the center, with 4 dandelions and 4 glistering melon slices around it.$(br2)§lEffect: §r$(br)Active while held or embedded in armor: max health increases to 100; healing speed is equivalent to Regeneration IV; hunger and saturation drain is reduced by 90%; Disciplinary Flash: when health reaches 50%, immediately restore 33% of max health.
Recipe: place a Golden Apple in the center, surrounded by 4 dandelions and 4 glistering melon slices.
